releaseNotes: Tapping a message opens a compact quick-reaction palette beside it.
Double-tap heart and swipe-to-reply remain available without conflicting with single taps.
The selection toolbar now contains only Copy, Forward, Pin and Delete with one-word labels.
Chat rows use stable fixed measurements so every conversation renders and the list scrolls predictably.
Opening the Chats tab refreshes its server snapshot while concurrent bootstrap requests are deduplicated.
